items.passage0: In Stardew Valley, my farmhouse was very small, so Robin built a bigger one for me. Now I have a kitchen with a sink and a cabinet. I put a shelf behind my bed for my books. Every morning, I collect eggs from the chickens and carry them to the kitchen. My house is tidy now, and my cat sleeps on the carpet.
items.passage1: Our family has a chore chart. I get up at six thirty and make my bed. My brother takes out the garbage at seven fifteen. After dinner, at six forty-five, I clear the table. Dad does the dishes, and Mom puts our clothes in the washing machine. On Sundays, we clean the house together. Then we go to the park.
items.passage2: At our school, every class has a cleaning duty. This week, our class cleans the restroom on the second floor. We bring buckets of water and some soap. We clean the sinks and the toilets. Our teacher says, "Don't forget to wash your hands when you finish!" It's not fun, but everyone uses the restroom, so we all have to help.
items.passage3: My grandma is eighty years old. Her back hurts, so she can't carry heavy things. Every Saturday, I visit her and help. I carry her shopping bags and take out the garbage. Grandma doesn't allow me to climb on chairs, so I don't clean the high shelves. She always says, "Thank you, my little helper!" and gives me a big hug.
items.passage4: In our town game, Lily's flower shop was a mess after market day. There was garbage on the floor, and there were empty boxes behind the door. Mia collected the garbage and put it in the trash can. Ben carried the boxes outside. Leo built a new shelf for the flower pots. In one hour, the shop was tidy again. To say thank you, Lily gave everyone a flower.
